description: "Geocode [address]" / "find [city] coordinates" / "search for places named [X]" / "where is [landmark]" — geocode an address or place name to coordinates via Pelias (OpenStreetMap-backed). Returns ranked candidates with lat/lng, address components, layer (venue/street/locality/region). Use as a free alternative to Mapbox/Google geocoding, or when you want OpenStreetMap-curated data.
name: geocode_search
